subject.title: fix(fleet): gateway token is echoed raw to the terminal in create and restore commands

question: Should normal human-readable fleet creation continue to reveal a newly generated gateway token once, and what supported mechanism should protect redirected or retained terminal output without removing that delivery path?
rationale: The existing test and retained “Shown once” message establish an intentional delivery contract; replacing it requires choosing a new operator retrieval and automation policy, not merely changing formatting.

options.title: Preserve shown-once delivery
options.body: Restore raw token output for the normal human create flow and consider a separate, reviewed masking design later.

options.title: Adopt a replacement retrieval flow
options.body: Only remove terminal delivery after adding and proving an explicit, documented way for the operator to securely obtain and store the generated token.

recommendation.title: Preserve shown-once delivery
recommendation.body: Restore raw token output for the normal human create flow and consider a separate, reviewed masking design later.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidenced participant who has traced the affected delivery contract and regression; repository ownership history should be consulted before selecting the long-term policy.
